The user requested a specific format: assign categories to the questions, refrain from extraneous words, list only one topic per sentence, and adhere to a line-by-line format.

Assistant A included the numbers (1, 2, 3, 4), which were not requested and could be considered extraneous words.
Assistant B provided only the categories, one per line, ending each with a period to satisfy the "one topic per sentence" requirement.

Assistant B followed the negative constraints more strictly.
